strategy: biology-informed balance: proportional allocation across GO-category x degree strata; <=50 cells/target; 2000 non-targeting controls
effect_blindness: no perturbation-effect magnitude, DE, or fold-change feature was used at any sampling step
go_overlap_handling: GO terms covering >= 50 eligible targets are anchors; each gene assigned to its rarest anchor (most specific); full multi-membership recorded
